integrated density is mean gray * area
```{r}
default_directory <- "C:\\Users\\Samantha\\Claycomb Lab Dropbox\\Claycomb Lab Team Folder\\Julie Claycomb\\TURBO ID MANUSCRIPT 04_2026\\Primary Data\\WAGO-4_Imaging\\withROIs"


df <- data.frame()

# Get a list of all Measurements.txt files in the directory
file_list <- list.files(default_directory, pattern = "Measurements\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)

# Loop through each file
for (file in file_list) {
  data <- fread(file, header = TRUE)

  # Extract Strain, Treatment, Worm from the file name by splitting on "_"
  # and reading from the end, since Strain can contain an underscore
  file_name <- basename(file)
  file_stem <- sub("\\.txt$", "", file_name)
  parts <- strsplit(file_stem, "_")[[1]]
  n <- length(parts)

  # Last token is "Measurements", second-to-last is Worm, third-to-last is Treatment
  worm <- parts[n - 1]
  treatment <- parts[n - 2]
  strain <- paste(parts[1:(n - 3)], collapse = "_")

  data$Strain <- strain
  data$Treatment <- treatment
  data$Worm <- worm

  df <- rbind(df, data)
}

IntDenByPair <- df %>%
  mutate(Region = ifelse(Label == "Inner", "Inner", "XOR")) %>%
  group_by(Strain, Treatment, Worm, Pair, Region) %>%
  summarise(totalRawIntDen = sum(RawIntDen, na.rm = TRUE),
            totalArea = sum(Area, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(density = totalRawIntDen / totalArea) %>%
  select(-totalRawIntDen, -totalArea) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Region,
    values_from = density
  ) %>%
  mutate(Ratio = Inner / XOR)

# Mean Ratio per worm (averaging across all 10 ROI pairs within that worm)
IntDenMeanByWorm <- IntDenByPair %>%
  group_by(Strain, Treatment, Worm) %>%
  summarise(meanRatio = mean(Ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# Overall mean Ratio per Strain × Treatment (averaging across worms)
IntDenMeanByTreatment <- IntDenMeanByWorm %>%
  group_by(Strain, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(overallMeanRatio = mean(meanRatio, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_ratio = sd(meanRatio, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n(),
            sem_ratio = sd_ratio / sqrt(n),
            .groups = "drop")
```
